title: Northbeam TechWorks Receivables: Restating the Labour a Surcharge Acts On
content:
Once the labour figure for an attendance on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job has been identified, that figure is then taken as follows.

**Where write-offs already stand on the job**, the write-offs recorded on it come off the labour figure before the surcharge is worked out.

**Where no write-off stands on the job and the labour was booked at a rate other than the service's own hourly rate**, the labour figure is restated as the hours recorded on the latest labour entry multiplied by the service's hourly rate. The hours read are the hours on the latest labour entry, by the day of the attendance it belongs to, and the rate applied is the hourly rate of the TechWorks service the job is handled under.

**Where neither of those situations holds**, the labour figure is taken as it was booked.

## The three readings side by side

| Write-offs standing on the job | The rate the labour was booked at | How the labour figure is taken |
| --- | --- | --- |
| any | any | the write-offs recorded on the job come off it |
| none | other than the service's own hourly rate | the hours on the latest labour entry, multiplied by the service's hourly rate |
| none | the service's own hourly rate | as it was booked |

The first line governs whenever any write-off stands on the job, whatever rate the labour was booked at; the second is reached only where no write-off stands.

## Illustrations on hypothetical jobs

*The amounts below are chosen for the illustration and are not figures of any job on file.*

**No write-off, and the service's own rate.** A hypothetical job under TechWorks Home Theatre Calibration, whose hourly rate is 159.00 USD, carries labour booked at that rate and no write-off. Neither of the first two situations holds, so the labour figure is taken as it was booked.

**No write-off, and an unusual rate.** The same job carries no write-off, and its latest labour entry records 3.5 hours at 132.50 USD an hour, a rate other than the 159.00 USD an hour the service carries. The figure is restated as 3.5 hours multiplied by 159.00 USD an hour, which is 556.50 USD.

**Write-offs standing.** The same job carries a labour figure of 214.60 USD and a write-off of 28.00 USD. The write-off recorded on the job comes off the labour figure, so the figure the surcharge is worked out on is 186.60 USD — and this holds whatever rate the labour was booked at.
